deltas.subject: CoTwilight+ parallel close-safe lifecycle and attention-time-to-independence
tests: fresh-successor pickup should not require original provider chat
settled work must not be blindly rerun
close-safe may precede total work completion
parallelize H0/read-only/research work while serializing consequence gates
deltas.expected_benefit: Lower CoCloseSafeLatency+, CoAttentionDebt+, and CoSessionDependencyArea+ while increasing CoTwilightYield+.
risks: parallel fan-out can amplify duplicate work without convergence
close-safe can be overclaimed if the durable frontier or pending work is not externally recoverable
wake_conditions: shared scheduler gains measurable close-safe metrics
cross-session convergence reports duplicate or conflicting ownership

deltas.subject: Protocol-neutral relational semantic substrate with relatable relations and bounded recursion
tests: project one bounded relational package through filesystem JSON and one MCP-like or local-mock adapter
round-trip both projections with explicit loss accounting
fresh receiver answers a bounded relation-about-relation query
deltas.expected_benefit: Permit protocol replacement without semantic rewrite while exposing projection loss, preserving provenance, and keeping authority outside transport.
risks: recursive relation graphs can create traversal explosion
adapter conformance may be mistaken for semantic truth or authority
wake_conditions: MCP-like adapter round-trip canary becomes available
a new open protocol dominates an existing adapter on a measured dimension

deltas.subject: Scale metabolism for session pressure, bounded self-models, energy allocation, selective subscriptions, and constrained wants
tests: session bounded self-model remains small as global object count grows
selective subscriptions reduce foreground context pressure
backlog optionality remains separable from active burden
CoWant+ does not imply authority, permission, or sentience
deltas.expected_benefit: Reduce global-keeping-up pressure and human-attention multiplication while preserving optionality in typed backlog reservoirs.
risks: self-observation can recursively create more work
pressure metrics can become administrative overhead if over-instrumented
wake_conditions: measured CoCoordinationPressure+ rises faster than useful fan-in
RickBar begins exposing low-value global state
backlog size is being mistaken for active burden

deltas.subject: One bounded local worker native lifecycle self-announcement canary
tests: same worker PID self-emits START and STOP
separate receiver validates event and result coherence
deltas.expected_benefit: Reduce lifecycle-adapter dependence and improve bounded worker observability, recovery, and future machine-owned continuation.
risks: one native worker canary may be overgeneralized to all workers or global enforcement
wake_conditions: second distinct worker class proves the same native lifecycle schema

deltas.subject: Turtles are welcome. Unbounded turtles with write permission are not.
tests: do not present the phrase as a runtime or security claim
deltas.expected_benefit: Provide a memorable, remixable public explanation of bounded recursive relational architecture.
risks: memeable phrasing can be mistaken for architectural sufficiency
wake_conditions: public highlight registry gains typed humour assets
